import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts_path, mapping_path, layout_path = sys.argv[1:4]
counts_raw = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
counts_raw.index = counts_raw.index.astype(str)
if counts_raw.index.has_duplicates:
    raise ValueError("Duplicate Ensembl identifiers in counts matrix")
counts = counts_raw.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="raise")
if counts.shape[1] != 30:
    raise ValueError(f"Expected 30 count samples, found {counts.shape[1]}")
if (counts < 0).to_numpy().any():
    raise ValueError("Counts must be non-negative")
if not np.equal(counts.to_numpy(), np.floor(counts.to_numpy())).all():
    raise ValueError("Counts must be integer-valued")
counts = counts.astype("int64")

# The requested experiment-level prefilter uses every one of the 30 samples.
prefilter_mask = (counts > 10).any(axis=1)
counts_prefiltered = counts.loc[prefilter_mask].copy()

layout = pd.read_csv(layout_path, dtype=str)
required_layout = {"SampleID", "Group"}
if not required_layout.issubset(layout.columns):
    raise ValueError("sample_layout.csv must contain SampleID and Group columns")
layout["count_id"] = layout["SampleID"].str.replace("-", "_", regex=False)
if layout["count_id"].duplicated().any():
    raise ValueError("Duplicate count sample identifiers in sample layout")
if set(layout["count_id"]) != set(counts.columns):
    missing = sorted(set(counts.columns) - set(layout["count_id"]))
    extra = sorted(set(layout["count_id"]) - set(counts.columns))
    raise ValueError(f"Sample mismatch; missing={missing[:5]}, extra={extra[:5]}")

mapping = pd.read_csv(mapping_path, sep="\t", dtype=str)
if mapping.shape[1] < 2:
    raise ValueError("Annotation mapping must have Ensembl and gene-name columns")
mapping = mapping.iloc[:, :2].copy()
mapping.columns = ["gene_id", "gene_name"]
mapping["gene_id"] = mapping["gene_id"].astype(str).str.strip()
mapping["gene_name"] = mapping["gene_name"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
if mapping["gene_id"].duplicated().any():
    conflicts = mapping[mapping["gene_id"].duplicated(keep=False)].groupby("gene_id")["gene_name"].nunique()
    if (conflicts > 1).any():
        raise ValueError("Conflicting gene-name mappings for an Ensembl identifier")
    mapping = mapping.drop_duplicates("gene_id", keep="first")
gene_to_name = mapping.set_index("gene_id")["gene_name"]

# Fit the requested four-level model, retaining all four related treatment groups.
model_groups = [
    "DMSO",
    "DMSO_Serum_starvation",
    "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50",
    "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h",
]
layout_by_count = layout.set_index("count_id").loc[counts_prefiltered.columns]
selected = layout_by_count["Group"].isin(model_groups)
if selected.sum() != 12:
    raise ValueError(f"Expected 12 samples in the four related groups, found {selected.sum()}")
counts_model = counts_prefiltered.loc[:, selected.to_numpy()].copy()
metadata = layout_by_count.loc[selected, ["Group"]].copy()
metadata["Group"] = pd.Categorical(metadata["Group"], categories=model_groups, ordered=False)
metadata.index = counts_model.columns
if list(metadata.index) != list(counts_model.columns):
    raise ValueError("Metadata and count columns are not aligned")

n_cpus = max(1, int(os.environ.get("GALAXY_SLOTS", "1")))
dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_model,
    metadata=metadata,
    design="~Group",
    refit_cooks=True,
    n_cpus=n_cpus,
)
dds.deseq2()
stat_res = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=["Group", "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50", "DMSO"],
    alpha=0.05,
    n_cpus=n_cpus,
)
stat_res.summary()
results = stat_res.results_df.copy()
if len(results) != len(counts_model.index):
    raise ValueError("Unexpected PyDESeq2 result row count")
results.index = counts_model.index
results.index.name = "gene_id"
results = results.rename(columns={
    "log2FoldChange": "log2FoldChange",
    "baseMean": "baseMean",
    "lfcSE": "lfcSE",
    "stat": "stat",
    "pvalue": "pvalue",
    "padj": "padj",
})
results.insert(0, "gene_id", results.index.astype(str))
results.insert(1, "gene_name", results["gene_id"].map(gene_to_name))
result_columns = ["gene_id", "gene_name", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj"]
for col in result_columns:
    if col not in results.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing expected PyDESeq2 result column: {col}")
results[result_columns].to_csv("deseq_results.tsv", sep="\t", index=False, na_rep="NA")

# The foreground is all mapped genes passing all three requested filters, in either direction.
foreground = results.loc[
    results["padj"].notna()
    & results["log2FoldChange"].notna()
    & results["baseMean"].notna()
    & (results["padj"] <= 0.05)
    & (results["log2FoldChange"].abs() >= 0.5)
    & (results["baseMean"] >= 10),
    "gene_name",
]
foreground = foreground[foreground.notna() & foreground.ne("")]
foreground = pd.unique(foreground.astype(str))
Path("foreground_genes.txt").write_text("\n".join(sorted(foreground)) + ("\n" if len(foreground) else ""))

# The ORA universe is every mapped gene retained by the requested 30-sample prefilter.
background = gene_to_name.reindex(counts_prefiltered.index)
background = background[background.notna() & background.ne("")]
background = pd.unique(background.astype(str))
Path("background_genes.txt").write_text("\n".join(sorted(background)) + ("\n" if len(background) else ""))
PY
